# Aashish Jagini

> Engineer-turned-product-manager in Frisco, TX. Senior PM at McKinsey & Company on an internal platform team — shipped the firm's first production GenAI agents. Builds and runs Brain, a self-hosted AI memory server ($0/month) that his AI tools read through MCP. Writes about PM craft, GenAI measurement, and AI tooling.
